Shaping policy for ethical innovation in AI | Alex Engler

February 23, 2021 ·Alteryx Community ·View original ↗
  • Data Science and Tech

Originally published at https://community.alteryx.com/t5/Data-Science-Mixer-Podcast/Shaping-policy-for-ethical-innovation-in-AI-Alex-Engler/ba-p/720391

Alex Engler, Brookings Institution research fellow and data scientist, walks us through the present and future state of public policy regarding AI. We explore how policy, ethics and innovation interact, and what that means for data scientists’ everyday work.
